articles.title: Alleged Kimwolf Botmaster ‘Dort’ Arrested, Charged in U.S. and Canada
articles.summary: CISA contractor literally published AWS GovCloud keys on GitHub like it's a goddamn recipe blog. Lawmakers are rightfully losing their minds over the cybersecurity agency's own cybersecurity face-plant.

articles.title: Patch Tuesday, May 2026 Edition
articles.summary: The same CISA contractor exposed highly privileged AWS GovCloud credentials and internal systems on public GitHub. When the cybersecurity watchdog becomes the security disaster, you know we're living in peak irony.

articles.title: Cisco used AI to write security incident reports, with mixed results
articles.summary: Trump Mobile website allegedly leaked thousands of customers' data to anyone capable of sending an HTTP request. The "law and order" candidate's tech team apparently skipped the "secure your endpoints" lecture.

articles.title: Drupal Core SQL Injection Bug Actively Exploited, Added to CISA KEV
articles.summary: CVE-2026-48172 in LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin scores a perfect 10.0 CVSS and lets attackers run arbitrary scripts as root. When your vulnerability gets a perfect score, it's not something to celebrate.

articles.title: First VPN Dismantled in Global Takedown Over Use by 25 Ransomware Groups
articles.summary: Drupal Core SQL injection bug CVE-2026-9082 gets the CISA KEV treatment after active exploitation. Another day, another CMS proving that user input is basically digital poison.

articles.title: TechD Cybersecurity Launches TECHD ONE: AI-Native Unified Cybersecurity Platform
articles.summary: Megalodon campaign hit 5,561 GitHub repos with malicious CI/CD workflows in six hours using bot accounts. It's like watching someone speedrun the destruction of open source trust.

articles.title: SailPoint Announces New Integration with the Claude Compliance API to Provide Enterprise-Grade Identity Security for AI Platforms
articles.summary: Critical Windows 11 BitLocker flaw exploitable with a USB key has researchers claiming Microsoft intentionally built a backdoor. Either incompetence or malice - neither option is comforting from Redmond.

articles.title: GitHub Confirms 3,800 Internal Repos Stolen Through Poisoned VS Code Extension
articles.summary: TeamPCP gang is poisoning open source code at unprecedented scale, hitting hundreds of organizations. The supply chain is more toxic than a Twitter reply thread right now.

articles.title: CISA Adds Exploited Langflow and Trend Micro Apex One Vulnerabilities to KEV
articles.summary: GitHub confirms 3,800 internal repos stolen after employee installed malicious VS Code extension from TeamPCP. When even GitHub's own devs get pwned by supply chain attacks, nobody is safe.

articles.title: Microsoft Took a Step Toward Human Rights Accountability. Google and Amazon (and Others) Should Pay Attention!
articles.summary: EFF celebrates a win for encrypted messaging as end-to-end encryption continues protecting our digital conversations from surveillance. Sometimes the good guys actually win one.
